banner: This is the bundled copy of the import spec. Check https://build.lovebird.show/import/custom for the current rules.

flow: On /import/custom type their name, choose one GLB or FBX ('Choose their body'), tick 'I made this character or have permission to use it.', press 'Begin the hatch'
Body check: read the face level (FULL / PARTIAL / CUSTOM) and the animation path
Personality, Voice, Movement, Review ('Does this feel like <name>?'), then Talk (the screen test)
On the Talk page press 'Save to My Gallery'
To enter the show press 'Send backstage' and confirm in the 'Send <name> backstage?' dialog (terms). One character per person; custom imports wait for reviewer approval before spawning
Before the boat sails, 'Leave the line' on the Backstage boat card takes the character out; do this before deleting it
upload.rightsRequired: I made this character or have permission to use it.

glb.compressionNote: The web preview decodes Draco and meshopt. Uncompressed is the safest choice; compress only to get under the size limit.
glb.textures: Embed textures in the GLB (PNG or JPEG). External texture files do not travel with a single-file upload.

fbx.note: FBX goes through the offline normalizer and never loads at runtime, so it cannot carry a blendshape face and the browser cannot preview inside it. Convert to GLB for anything with a face.

vrm.note: The file picker does not accept .vrm. Convert to GLB in Blender (VRM add-on import, then glTF 2.0 export). VRM/VRoid bone names are recognised by the humanoid classifier; VRM expression and spring-bone extensions are not read.

metahuman.note: Export the low-poly body and face as ONE GLB on the MetaHuman skeleton with morph targets. /import/metahuman is DNA-only and nothing in the game reads DNA today.

blenderExport.include: Selected Objects or Visible Objects; include the armature
blenderExport.transform: +Y Up on; apply all transforms (Ctrl+A > All Transforms) before export; 1 Blender unit = 1 metre
blenderExport.data: Mesh: Apply Modifiers on, UVs on, Normals on; Material: Export; Images: Automatic or JPEG
blenderExport.shapeKeys: Shape Keys on (names travel in mesh.extras.targetNames)
blenderExport.skinning: Skinning on; Armature: Use Rest Position on
blenderExport.animation: Animation on; Actions as NLA tracks or 'Actions' mode so each action becomes a named clip; Always Sample Animations on
blenderExport.compression: Draco off unless you must get under 250 MB

enforced: unsupported rigs must map one clip to Idle

recommended.note: Triangle and texture numbers are budgets, not upload gates. The live show renders many characters at once on phones; heavy bodies slow everyone's stream.

rig.oneSkeleton: Any number of skinned meshes may share one armature. Two unrelated skeletons in one file are refused.

supportedHumanoid.rule: Dictionary match of the 22 humanoid roles, every required role mapped, confidence >= 0.80
supportedHumanoid.onAccept: No clip needed. Inherits every Love Bird body animation on its own proportions.

rig.metahumanInGameCheck: Same bone names and parents as the reference body, bone length within 5 percent, rest rotation within 5 degrees.
rig.otherRigs: Birds, creatures, vehicles, props and unrecognised humanoids must bring at least one clip and map it to Idle on the Movement page. Talk and emotions are optional. Name moving parts plainly: body, leg_1, wing_L, tail, wheel_1, eye_L, eyelid_upper_L, brow_L.

blendshapes.matching: Case-insensitive after normalisation: non-alphanumerics stripped, trailing _L/_R/.L/.R read as Left/Right, one leading arkit/blendshape/bs/shapekey prefix stripped.

emotion.custom: Any other EMO_ name (EMO_Love, EMO_Fear, EMO_Mischief) is kept as a custom emotion. Emotion names never block an upload.

levels.full: every required blink, mouth and core emotion present
levels.partial: uploads with notes; a missing emotion shows a neutral face
levels.none: no face shapes; the body still uploads

blendshapes.visemes: Viseme-named shapes (aa, oh, PP) can be pointed at ARKit channels in Advanced > Custom Visemes.

animation.emotionClipNaming: <Emotion>_Idle and <Emotion>_Talking (also <Emotion>_Talk), for example Neutral_Idle, Neutral_Talking, Happy_Idle, Happy_Talking
animation.customRoles: custom.<slug> (lowercase letters, digits, underscore, up to 40)
rules: Idle must not carry root motion
Missing roles fall back to a related clip, then to procedural motion

knownIssues.symptom: Face shows no expressions after an FBX upload
knownIssues.workaround: Re-export as GLB with Shape Keys on; FBX faces are not loaded at runtime

knownIssues.symptom: After deleting a character that was backstage, 'You already have a character on Love Bird Live' blocks sending another
knownIssues.workaround: Use 'Leave the line' on the boat card BEFORE deleting. If already stuck, report a bug with surface 'backstage'

knownIssues.symptom: Name field cannot be changed after the character is saved
knownIssues.workaround: Names are fixed once created. Create a new character with the new name

knownIssues.symptom: Signed out, a second browser counts as a different person
knownIssues.workaround: Sign in before sending backstage so the one-character-per-person rule follows you

rulesPendingRelease.note: Accepted once the universal-expressions release is live. Until live is true, author the canonical names in blendshapes/animation above. Fermata flips live:true in the live spec.

alsoMapped: MetaHuman CTRL_expressions_* (browRaiseInL, mouthCornerPullL/R, mouthCornerDepressL/R, eyeWidenL, noseWrinkleL, jawOpen, mouthLipsPurse*, mouthFunnel*)
VRM/VRoid (Fcl_ALL_Joy/Angry/Sorrow/Fun/Surprised as emotion shapes; Fcl_MTH_A/O; A/I/U/E/O; aa/oh/ou/ee/ih)
Oculus / Ready Player Me visemes viseme_*
blendshapes.matching: Ignores case, underscores and side suffixes (_L, .L, L, Left) and the prefixes arkit, blendShape1., bs, Wolf3D_Head., A01_, Genesis8 facs_bs_
blendshapes.unrecognised: Kept as custom channels; never an error

emotions.guidance: Name whole-face poses EMO_<AnyWord>. With ARKit or MetaHuman channels you need no EMO_ shapes at all.

clips.newEmotions: Any word before _Idle/_Talking registers a new emotion

rig.nonHumanoid: No requirements. Bones named head, jaw|beak_lower|mandible, tail*, wing* and ear* get emote motion and beak lip-sync automatically.

rulesPendingRelease.gallery: Owners can edit any emotion live with the Expressions button in the talk view.
